note: Formulary entries that still name a product the NHS Dictionary of Medicines and Devices (dm+d) records as discontinued. Hand-curated: each line was read at its own source on the date shown and is quoted as printed (a table row is its cells in reading order; '...' marks text left out). Each listing points at an item id in data/speciality-local-intel.json, which supplies the organisation, document, date and link, so a source that is withdrawn there drops out here. The dm+d status is read from the dm+d browser record; whether a product is in Part IX is checked at build time against the Hub's own Part IX file.
